name: When should a business consider renovating its commercial space?

mainEntity.name: When should a business consider renovating its commercial space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Businesses should consider renovating when their current space no longer meets operational needs, customer expectations, or brand image. This includes outdated aesthetics, inefficient layouts, failing infrastructure, or the need to accommodate growth or new technologies. Renovations can improve employee productivity, attract more clients, and enhance property value, offering a strong return on investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider renovating when your space is outdated, inefficient, or no longer meets operational needs or brand image.
